movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Handkerchief use central; flirtatious waving and gestures; male assertive hand movements
movement_profile.footwork: Barefoot, basic steps with turns, hip sways, and cockfight-inspired figures; tempo accelerates through dance
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couple facing each other, interacting closely; spatial path mostly stationary with turns and side steps
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Hip and waist movements influenced by gypsy bulerías style; fluid but assertive
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: No jumps described; levels mostly upright with fluid hip movements
movement_profile.partnering: Non-contact flirtation with handkerchief interaction; no lifts or holds described

signature_moves.description: Body and hand gestures mimicking fighting roosters
signature_moves.name: Cockfight Figure

signature_moves.description: Gypsy-style hip and waist movements expressing machismo and flirtation
signature_moves.name: Hip Sway

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Starts slow and lyrical, builds to fast, passionate climax
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid imposing external interpretations; respect the dance as a cultural courtship expression; do not perform sacred or restricted gestures not described.

music_profile.meter: not explicitly described, implied compound or duple with syncopation
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Characteristic 'tundete' bass line on guitar; 'Golpe de Tierra' percussion accelerates rhythm
music_profile.sound_description: The music opens with a slow, tragic vocal over a steady guitar bass line, gradually accelerating with cajón, spoons, and hand claps into a lively, rhythmic finale evoking mule steps and gypsy trumpet bands.
music_profile.tempo_bpm: variable, slow to fast across sections
music_profile.vocal_style: Principal singer with small chorus; lyrical, tragic ballad style (triste or cumanana), picaresque and passionate

basic_steps: Woman holds a handkerchief, performs wide skirt turns.
Man uses handkerchief to gesture assertively.
Perform flirtatious arm and hip movements.

Increase tempo progressively through dance sections.
teaching.formation: Couple dance, facing each other, interacting closely.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with basic handkerchief handling and simple flirtatious steps; intermediate adds cockfight figures and tempo changes; advanced includes nuanced hip and waist movements.
teaching.rhythm: Three-part rhythm: glosa (slow, lyrical), dulce (medium, choral), fuga (fast, passionate).
